lee_wald.statement: Five Taub covectors are slice-independent on the closed cylinder.

resonance.statement: The bounded P/R ledger is complete, but its unrestricted real common zero is open.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: Necessary and sufficient blockwise P/R/moment ledger; global zero locus open.

smooth_secular.statement: Exactly the five moment maps obstruct finite EP correction.

taub_maps.statement: Exactly H, Px and three lifted rotations survive in the EP cokernel.
